title: Squash and bacon soup with broccoli

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Bacon, onion, garlic, squash, chicken stock, tinned butter beans, broccoli and sage are all ordinary home ingredients.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday item at any mainstream supermarket.

basic_kitchen.reason: A large pan and a stick blender for soup are ordinary kit, and the technique is simple.

works.reason: 1kg squash, a litre of stock, a tin of beans and a head of broccoli make a sensible thick soup for four, with clear timings and bacon for seasoning.

honest_times.reason: 25 minutes is fair for peeling and cubing the squash, chopping the rest and frying the bacon and onion, and 30 minutes matches the simmering.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used in the steps, the names match their ids, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: A warming squash soup suits mid-September, and the squash is the body of the dish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, plain British English that a beginner could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: A filling soup with squash, beans, broccoli and bacon is a proper family dinner.
